descriptors.title: simulation.environment.online_source.live_document.bind
descriptors.description: Bind the source and document from one verified current-open launch receipt atomically.
descriptors.use_when: The owner has completed a Teamcenter launch major 2.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: The current-open receipt is unavailable or outside the owner runtime scope.
descriptors.business_effect: Atomically bind one verified launch major 2 source/document receipt and persist its local interaction source association.
business_acceptance_criteria: The signed current-open receipt binds source selector and document identity to the same fresh owner runtime.
Source association, live binding, document device, workspace revision and idempotency result commit or roll back together.
No independent identity read or saved environment document identity is required.

business_invariants.statement: A source association is established only from a verified signed current-open launch receipt.
business_invariants.applies_when: an online source is bound for local interaction

descriptors.side_effects: Writes domain state through the owning Provider.

transaction_policy.atomicity: verified opened-source evidence/source association/live binding/document/workspace revision/idempotency in one transaction

transaction_policy.idempotency: workspace/key plus launch receipt/runtime/document/source and expected workspace revision

descriptors.title: simulation.teamcenter.visualization.launch
descriptors.description: Open an exact Teamcenter source and attest the resulting native document.
descriptors.use_when: A signed launch major 2 plan invokes the current-open adapter.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: The caller is outside the trusted local runtime.
descriptors.business_effect: Open one exact Teamcenter online source as a new VisMockup document using official launch information.
business_acceptance_criteria: The operation is scoped to the caller's single bound Simulation Connector.
The closed request and response contracts preserve exact Connector and Adapter identity.
Rejected operations do not create ungoverned Teamcenter product-data or VisMockup side effects.
descriptors.no_business_invariant_reason: Identity, contract and execution-plan validation fully determine this atomic boundary; no additional business-state rule is decided here.
descriptors.side_effects: Writes domain state through the owning Provider.

descriptors.title: simulation.viewer.interaction.authorize
descriptors.description: Resolve or authorize an owned current-open viewer source association.
descriptors.use_when: The authenticated owner opens or renews a local interactive session.
descriptors.do_not_use_when: There is no verified current-open binding or the caller is automated.
descriptors.business_effect: Issue a 60-second signed local interaction grant scoped to the current owner, device, source and opened document.
business_acceptance_criteria: The workspace, primary online-source document, active binding and current runtime belong to the authenticated owner and tenant.
Caller input cannot select device, runtime, operations, actor, tenant or authorization lifetime.
Renewal retains the same session nonce and allocates a strictly increasing generation only after current-scope revalidation.

business_invariants.statement: Local interaction authority exists only for one active verified source association and authenticated runtime.
business_invariants.applies_when: an owner resolves or authorizes a local viewer interaction

descriptors.side_effects: Writes domain state through the owning Provider.
